rationales.seed_block: A distinct contiguous 64-world block prevents reuse of V2.0 draws and stays below escrow.
rationales.precision_support: Spans flattened, baseline, and visibly sharpened likelihoods without numerical extremes.
rationales.base_likelihood: Leaves room for precision to change evidence weight in either direction.
rationales.monitor_reliability: Makes local state recoverable but not observed directly.
rationales.phi_prior: A uniform hyper-prior lets the doubly stochastic broadcast CPT preserve local marginal inference.
rationales.broadcast_cpt: Doubly stochastic rows preserve the local marginal under a uniform Phi prior.
